name: Electronics and home appliances retail

problems.words: Qist wale teen chaar qiston ke baad dena band kar dete hain
quick_ideas: List every installment account with its last payment date once, so you see who is late
Call the oldest late accounts first, so effort goes where risk is highest.

workzap_build.text: an installment ledger with account codes, schedule, paid, due and overdue days, and a daily overdue list.

problems.free_stops: How accounts are coded and overdue lists produced is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many installment accounts stopped after a few payments this month, so you see where collection slippage is heaviest.
Give one staff member the job of reviewing stopped installment accounts every evening from one notebook, so late payers are chased sooner.

problems.words: Recovery wala cash laata hai, pata nahi sab jama hua ya nahi
quick_ideas: Match the recovery man's copy with your register once, so you see if they agree
Give a receipt for every collection, so the customer has proof too.

workzap_build.text: collections logged on phone with a WhatsApp receipt to the customer and daily collector cash reconciliation.

problems.ask_first: When does the collected cash reach you?
problems.free_stops: How collections are logged and reconciled is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare each recovery visit noted by the collector with the cash entered that day once, so missing deposits stand out quickly.
Make one cashier sign for every recovery cash handover in one register, so responsibility stays clear from collection to deposit.

problems.words: Serial number note nahi karte, warranty claim pe behas hoti hai
quick_ideas: Write the serial number on every invoice from today, so claims have proof
Note serials of godown stock once, so you start with a clean list.

workzap_build.text: serial capture at purchase, sale and delivery, linked to invoice and warranty dates.

problems.ask_first: Do you scan or write serials today?
problems.free_stops: How serials are captured and linked is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count this week's sales invoices missing serial numbers once, so you see how often warranty disputes are being invited.
Give the invoice writer the job of noting every sold unit serial in one register, so warranty claims are settled with store proof.

problems.words: June mein installation team ek hafte peeche, customers naraz
quick_ideas: List pending installations by area once, so teams can cover one area per trip
Give customers a realistic slot, so they aren't left waiting at home.

workzap_build.text: an installation scheduler by zone and slot, with installer assignment and job completion with photo and customer sign-off.

problems.ask_first: Do you install yourselves or through outside technicians?
problems.free_stops: How zones, slots and assignments are set is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note how many pending installations are older than one week by area once, so the backlog shape is clear for dispatch.
Give one dispatcher the job of keeping one daily installation list, so teams leave with a clear handover each morning.

problems.words: Warranty claim brand ke paas hafton lagta hai
quick_ideas: List every open claim with its date once, so you can chase the oldest
Give the customer a status update on each, so they hear from you before calling.

workzap_build.text: a claim tracker by brand with status updates sent to the customer.

problems.free_stops: The claim stages and update messages are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many warranty claims have waited more than two weeks once, so you see which cases are hurting trust most.
Give one person the job of updating every open claim from one list each afternoon, so customers hear progress before they complain.

problems.words: Brand ke schemes ka pata nahi kitna milna hai
quick_ideas: Write down each brand's current scheme and your sales against it once, so you know what you should be owed
Ask each brand for its statement, so you can compare the two.

workzap_build.text: a scheme and rebate tracker: target, achieved, due and received.

problems.ask_first: How many brands do you deal with?
problems.free_stops: How sales are matched to each scheme is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare each brand scheme promised with what actually reached your account once, so shortfalls are spotted before the season ends.
Give one person one notebook for all brand scheme notes and receipts, so claims are chased from one complete record.

problems.words: Facebook ads se installment leads aati hain, salesman call hi nahi karte
quick_ideas: Count this week's leads and how many got a call, so the gap is clear
Give each lead to a named salesman, so no lead belongs to nobody.

workzap_build.text: every enquiry recorded, assigned and reminded until followed up, with response times visible.

problems.ask_first: Where do most leads come from?
problems.free_stops: How leads are assigned and reminders timed is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count this week's installment leads against completed salesman calls once, so the gap shows before leads go cold.
Give one supervisor the job of assigning every new installment lead from one page, so no enquiry sits untouched all day.

problems.words: AC season ka stock jua hai
quick_ideas: Pull last summer's sales by model and tonnage once, so buying starts from facts
Note which models ran out and when, so you order those earlier.

workzap_build.text: an AC season planner from past sales by model and tonnage.

problems.ask_first: Does your POS keep last year's sales by model?
problems.free_stops: How the planner uses past seasons is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare last hot season's fastest selling cooling models with what is on hand now once, so buying guesses get grounded.
Give one buyer one running list of requested cooling models not available, so missed demand shapes the next purchase plan.

problems.words: Showroom aur godown ki stock list alag hai
quick_ideas: Count your top models in both places once, so you see where the lists disagree
Decide which list is the master, so salesmen quote from one source.

workzap_build.text: one stock across showroom, godown and marketplaces.

problems.free_stops: How the setup connects together is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count the same fast moving models in showroom and godown once, so list mismatches are seen on items that matter daily.
Give one stock clerk the job of writing every movement in one shared register, so showroom and godown updates follow one routine.

never_say: Interest, markup or Shariah rulings on installments, or financing advice.
Recovery by threats or seizing goods.
Electrical, gas or wiring safety advice; for fire, shock or gas leaks, emergency services first.
Selling grey imports as warranty-backed or altering serials.
To collect CNICs, guarantor details or cheques.

sample_reply.person: Qiston pe saman dete hain, 300 ke qareeb accounts hain, recovery ka koi hisaab nahi. Kya karein?
sample_reply.pi:
Haan, is par kaam ho sakta hai, aur pehla qadam aasan hai.
Pehle, har account ki aakhri qist ki tareekh ek dafa list kar lein, taa ke pata chale kaun late hai.
Doosra, recovery wale ki copy apne register se ek dafa mila lein, taa ke dono ka farq saamne aaye.
Workzap ye tayyar kar sakta hai: installment ledger jis mein roz late accounts ki list aaye, aur har collection pe customer ko WhatsApp receipt aur shaam ko cash ka hisaab.

Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
